task.title: P6-132: Qualify the result count so it stops misstating page N as the whole result set
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-132. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**The result count states *this page's* row count with no page qualifier** (was `P6-042a`; `catalog.rs:279-281`), so the last page of a 73-result search reads "23 results" while mid-pages read "50+ results" — and the same number feeds the mobile filter sheet's "Show N results" footer. Keyset has no offset, so a "51–73 of 73" form needs a separate count query or a page ordinal in the URL.
